summary: [¶] 31.3.2021 in respect of the transmission asset as per the details given below. The capital cost incurred up to COD and projected to be incurred during 2021-22 is duly certified in the Auditor Certificate. [para 15] 15. The Petitioner has submitted the Auditor’s Certificate and has claimed the following capital cost incurred as on COD and Additional Capital Expenditure (ACE) projected to be incurred in 2021-22, in respect of the transmission asset: [para 19] 19. Therefore, the Petitioner has requested to consider the above-mentioned _force majeure_ issues, which were beyond the control of the Petitioner and condone the time overrun in the completion of the transmission asset under Regulation 22(2)(c) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations and approve the tariff as claimed. [para 27] 27. We have considered the submissions for the Petitioner and TANGEDCO. It is observed that the Petitioner has claimed only the loan from HDFC, which was drawn on 30.4.2021, and it is after SCOD (i.e. 10.1.2021). Since the time overrun of 110 days has been disallowed, the IDC claim amounting to `0.71 lakh is disallowed. Further, the Petitioner has claimed an IEDC of `62.61 lakh and has submitted an Auditor’s Certificate in support of the same. The Petitioner has also submitted that the entire IEDC has been discharged as on COD in respect of the transmission asset. Hence, the allowable IEDC has been worked out on the pro-rata basis of the total number of allowable days and the total number of days taken for execution of the transmission asset. Accordingly, the details of IDC and IEDC allowed and disallowed is as follows: [para 28] 28. The Petitioner has not claimed any Initial Spares for the transmission asset. Accordingly, the capital cost allowed in respect of the transmission asset as on COD is as follows: [para 32] 32. Accordingly, the capital cost allowed as on 31.3.2024 is as follows: [para 53] 53. The Petitioner has sought reimbursement of capital spares at the end of the tariff period. The Petitioner’s claim, if any, shall be dealt with in accordance with the provisions of the 2019 Tariff Regulations. [para 54] 54. The COD of the asset is approved as 30.4.2021. title: Approval under Regulation 86 of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999 and Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 for determination of Transmission Tariff from Actual COD to 31.3.2024 for Asset-1: a) Shifting of 125 MVAR and 80 MVAR line reactors at Nellore (PG) from Nellore PS-Nellore (PG) 400 kV D/C Line to Nellore (PG)-Sriperumbudur 400 kV D/C Line (with suitable arrangement) and b) Bypassing Nellore PS-Nellore (PG) 400 kV D/C (Quad) line and Nellore (PG)-Thiruvalam 400 kV D/C Quad line at Nellore (PG) for making direct Nellore PS-Thiruvalam 400 kV D/C (Quad) Line under Transmission System for controlling High Loading of Nellore (PG)-Nellore PS 400 kV (Quad) D/C line in Southern Region.
